acip: BDAG GIS MTHUS BDAG GI MING RNA LAM DU GRAG CING, DE DAG GIS BDAG GI MING DRAN PA DANG, BRJOD PAS SNGON GYI LAS KYI SGRIB PA DE YONGS SU BYANG BAR GYUR CIG ,SKYE BA DE YANG THA MAR GYUR CIG
wylie: bdag gis mthus bdag gi ming rna lam du grag cing, de dag gis bdag gi ming dran pa dang, brjod pas sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa de yongs su byang bar gyur cig ,skye ba de yang tha mar gyur cig
english: May all these beings, by my mystic power, catch at some point the sound of my name; and later may they recall this name, and speak it.  And thus may they be cleaned, completely, of all their karmic obstacles from the past.  May that lifetime in the cycle of pain then be their last.
